title: sorbus wallichii
intro: Sorbus wallichii, commonly known as the Himalayan rowan or Bhutan rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine, exhibiting several health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various ailments such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus wallichii include its ability to reduce fever and inflammation, as well as its role in treating digestive issues and respiratory problems due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus wallichii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
